name: yasuo

scripts.//build: Vite is run through node with an explicit heap size rather than through its bin shim: rolling up the renderer — mermaid, katex, Excalidraw, and a Lezer parser per language — peaks over 2GB, and V8 sizes the default old space from physical memory, so a 7GB machine (a macOS CI runner, a smaller laptop) caps it at ~2GB and the build dies with CALL_AND_RETRY_LAST while a 16GB one never notices.
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json

//dependencies: Only what the packaged app loads at runtime. Everything the renderer uses is bundled by Vite and everything the main process uses is bundled by esbuild, so it belongs below — node-pty is the one esbuild external left, and it stays a real file in node_modules because it loads a prebuilt binary. `pg` and `mysql2` were here for the Database panel and went with it.
//trustedDependencies: bun does not run postinstall scripts unless a package is listed here; electron's is what downloads its binary.
//build.extraResources: install.sh is carried in the bundle so the in-app update button runs this build's own installer rather than a script fetched at the moment it is pressed. Outside the asar because bash has to execute a real file. This note lives out here because electron-builder validates the `build` object against a schema and rejects any key it does not know, `//`-prefixed or not.
//overrides: One @codemirror/view for the whole renderer. Milkdown already depends on the CodeMirror packages and resolves them at 6.43.8, so the app's own direct dependency resolving one patch newer put two copies in node_modules — which is not merely wasteful: a CodeMirror extension is identified by the class it was built from, so a keymap from one copy is not a keymap to the other, and tsc says so before the editor does. Pinned exact, and the direct dependency is pinned to match.
